mod_hdg.description: The default heading offset, θ∆ for any turn that does not specify a heading offset. The default value is 20 degrees.

turn_dir.description: The default turn direction for any turn that does specify a direction. The default direction is port.

p1.description: Sets one endpoint of the primary leg-run track line in local x,y coordinates.

p2.description: Sets the other endpoint of the primary leg-run track line in local x,y coordinates.

leg.description: Defines the primary leg-run track line by center point, angle, and length rather than by explicit p1 and p2 endpoints.

leg_len.description: Sets a new length for the primary leg-run track while preserving its center and angle. The behavior recalculates both endpoints from the new length.

leg_len_mod.description: Adds a runtime adjustment to the current primary-leg length while preserving the leg center and angle. The resulting length is bounded by leg_len_min.

leg_len_min.description: Sets the minimum allowed leg length when leg length is modified dynamically. The behavior enforces a lower safety bound on this value.

leg_ang.description: Sets a new angle for the primary leg-run track while preserving its center and length.

leg_ang_mod.description: Adds a runtime adjustment to the current primary-leg angle while preserving the leg center and length.

shift_pt.description: Moves the primary leg so its center is at the given x,y point while preserving the original leg length and angle.

turn_bias.description: The bias value, [−100, 100], may be adjusted with this parameter affecting the turn shape at both vertices. A value of −100 will result in a Williamson turn with its longest end aligned with the legrun track line (recommended). The default value is 0.

turn1_bias.description: The bias value, [−100, 100], may be adjusted with this parameter affecting the turn shape at vertex 1. A value of −100 will result in a Williamson turn with its longest end aligned with the legrun track line (recommended). The default value is 0.

turn2_bias.description: The bias value, [−100, 100], may be adjusted with this parameter affecting the turn shape at vertex 2. A value of −100 will result in a Williamson turn with its longest end aligned with the legrun track line (recommended). The default value is 0.

turn1_bias_mod.description: The bias value for the turn as vertex 1, may be dynamically adjusted with this parameter, during run time, affecting the turn shape at vertex 1. The given value will be added to the existing value. The resulting value will be clipped to the range [−100, 100].

turn2_bias_mod.description: The bias value for the turn as vertex 1, may be dynamically adjusted with this parameter, during run time, affecting the turn shape at vertex 2. The given value will be added to the existing value. The resulting value will be clipped to the range [−100, 100].

turn_bias_mod.description: The bias value for the turn as vertex 1, may be dynamically adjusted with this parameter, during run time, affecting the turn shape at both vertices. The given value will be added to the existing value. The resulting value will be clipped to the range [−100, 100].

turn_dir.description: The turn direction, "port" or "starboard", the vehicle will turn around both ver- tices. Acceptable parameter values are "port", "starboard", "star", or "toggle". The default is "star".

turn1_dir.description: The turn direction, "port" or "starboard", the vehicle will turn around the first vertex. Acceptable parameter values are "port", "starboard", "star", or "toggle". The default is "star".

turn2_dir.description: The turn direction, "port" or "starboard", the vehicle will turn around the second vertex. Acceptable parameter values are "port", "starboard", "star", or "toggle". The default is "star".

turn1_ext.description: An additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 1, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn2_ext.description: An additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 2, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn_ext.description: An additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on both ends, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn1_ext_mod.description: Modify the turn 1 extent, an additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 1, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn2_ext_mod.description: Modify the turn 2 extent, an additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 2, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn_ext_mod.description: For both turns, modify the turn extent, an additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on both ends, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

tur1_rad.description: The turn radius of the turn following vertex 1. Any positive value is allowed (yes, any, be carefull), and the default is 15 meters.

turn2_rad.description: The turn radius of the turn following vertex 2. Any positive value is allowed (yes, any, be carefull), and the default is 15 meters.

turn_rad.description: The turn radius of the turn following both vertices. Any positive value is allowed (yes, any, be carefull), and the default is 15 meters.

turn_rad_min.description: A minimum turn radius is enforced when dynamically adjusting the turn radius with the turn* rad mod parameters. This min radius is 5 meters. This can be changed with this parameter, but cannot be set lower than 2 meters.

turn1_rad_mod.description: The turn radius of the turn at vertex 1 may be modified with this parameter. It cannot be set lower than the value of turn rad min.

turn2_rad_mod.description: The turn radius of the turn at vertex 2 may be modified with this parameter. It cannot be set lower than the value of turn rad min.

turn_rad_mod.description: The turn radius of the turn at both vertices may be modified with this parameter. It cannot be set lower than the value of turn rad min.

turn_pt_gap.description: The distance between points comprising the Williamson turns on both ends. The default is 25 meters.

capture_line.description: When set to true, the behavior will regard a vertex as captured, if it crosses the line at the vertex perpendicular to the trackline. The default is false.

capture_radius.description: The radius to the target vertex within which the vehicle must arrive for a vertex to considered reached, or captured. The default value is 3 meters.

init_leg_mode.description: Selects the initial leg/turn mode used when the behavior starts. Use this when startup should force a particular first leg direction or mode.

lead.description: For trackline following during the legrun phase of this behavior, this parameter affects the severity of adjustment back to the trackline when there is a trackline error. The default value is 0, meaning no trackline error adjustment will be made.

lead_damper.description: When adjusting for trackine errors, this parameter will automatically reduce the trackline adjustments the closer the vehicle gets to the trackline. The default value is 0.

leg_spds.description: A schedule of speeds in m/s to be executed on each successive leg run.

leg_spds_onturn.description: If set, use this speed, in m/s on turns at the end of each leg run.

leg_spds_repeat.description: If true, and a schedule of speeds is provided with the leg spds parameter, then repeat the schedule once it has been exhausted.

leg_flag.description: A flag to be published on each helm iteration while the behavior is the mode of traversing either direction of the leg.

leg_endflag.description: A flag to be published at the end of each leg as the behavior transitions from either the leg1 mode into the turn1 mode, or from the leg2 mode into the turn2 mode.

leg1_endflag.description: A flag to be published as the behavior transitions from the leg1 mode into the turn1 mode.

leg2_endflag.description: A flag to be published as the behavior transitions from the leg2 mode into the turn2 mode.

mid_leg_flag.description: A flag to be published at a mid point position during the leg. The location of the mid point is determined by the mid leg pct parameter.

mid_leg_pct.description: The percentage [0, 100] of the primary leg, at which the behavior after first exceeding this point, will post any configured waypointmid leg flag postings.

mid_turn_flag.description: A flag to be published at a mid point position during a turn. The location of the mid point is determined by the mid turn pct parameter.

mid_turn_pct.description: The percentage [0, 100] of turn, at which the behavior will post any configured waypointmid turn flag postings.

patience.description: A patience parameter in the range of [1, 99] may be set to adust the relative weight between adjusting speed while maintaining course, or adjusting course while maintaining speed. The default value is 50.

slip_radius.description: A radius to the target vertex within which the vehicle will declare arrival as soon as the distance to the vertex begins to grow larger. The default value is 15 meters.

speed.description: The default speed in m/s if no schedule of speed is provided with the leg spds pa- rameter, or when the speed schedule has been exhausted with no leg spds repeat enabled.

wpt_status_var.description: The name of a MOOS variable to publish a status report.

repeat.description: The number of times the trackline leg will be repeated before this behavior completes. The default values is 0, meaning it will repeat endlessly. (check this)

turn_endflag.description: A flag to be published at the end of each leg as the behavior transitions from either the turn1 mode into the leg2 mode, or from the turn2 mode into the leg1 mode.

turn1_endflag.description: A flag to be published as the behavior transitions from the turn1 mode into the leg2 mode.

turn2_endflag.description: A flag to be published as the behavior transitions from the turn2 mode into the leg1 mode.

visual_hints.description: Settings for the posted visual artifacts of this behavior, includeing edge and vertex colors and sizes. See the example configuration block for supported parameters.

variable.description: Runtime coordination field used by BHV_LegRun status reporting. It is not a primary user-facing mission tuning parameter.

lr_mode.description: Runtime status value indicating the current leg-run phase, such as leg1, leg2, turn1, or turn2. This is normally reported by the behavior, not configured by users.

lr_mode_report.description: Runtime coordination report containing the current leg-run mode, vehicle name, and timestamp for multi-vehicle coordination.

lr_tcoord_spd.description: The speed currently the target speed for the behavior based on its relative position to other vehicles. Only relevant when turn coordination is enabled between multiple vehicles.

lr_now_spd.description: The speed currently the target speed for the behavior based on its relative position to other vehicles.

lr_os_degs.description: Runtime coordination value giving ownship position in degrees on the reference circle used by multi-vehicle leg-run coordination.

BHV_LegRun.description: The LegRun behavior enables a vehicle to repeatedly traverse back and forth over a legrun trackline prescribed by two vertices.  After reaching the end of the trackline, the vehicle switches into a Williamson turn mode to ensure the vehicle aligns with the trackline when starting in the other direction.

turn_range.description: The range of heading values deviating from the current heading average outside of which the behavior reflects sharp penalty in its objective function. BHV_MemoryTurnLimit.description: The objective of the Memory-Turn-Limit behavior is to avoid vehicle turns that may cross back on its own path and risk damage to the towed equipment.  Its configuration is determined by the two parameters described below which combine to set a vehicle turn radius limit.

parameter.description: Documentation table placeholder, not an ordinary behavior configuration parameter. Prefer the specific OpRegion parameters such as core_poly, save_poly, halt_poly, max_depth, min_altitude, and reset.

breached_altitude_flag.description: A MOOS variable-value pair to be posted when or if the vehicle breaches the altitude limit set by this behavior.

breached_depth_flag.description: A MOOS variable-value pair to be posted when or if the vehicle breaches the depth limit set by this behavior.

breached_poly_flag.description: A MOOS variable-value pair to be posted when or if the vehicle breaches the convex polygon op area limit set by this behavior.

breached_time_flag.description: A MOOS variable-value pair to be posted when or if the vehicle breaches the time limit set by this behavior.

core_poly.description: Defines the nominal operating area as a convex polygon. OpRegion behaviors use this as the primary region for containment and for deriving save/halt regions when distance offsets are configured.

draw_halt_status.description: If true, a small (by default red) polygon is drawn around the vehicle when or if it exits the halt polygon, following the vehicle until it returns to the within the halt polygon. The default is true.

draw_save_status.description: If true, a small (by default yellow) polygon is drawn around the vehicle when or if it exits the save polygon, following the vehicle until it returns to the within the save polygon. The default is true.

halt_poly.description: Defines the hard containment polygon. When the vehicle exits this polygon, the behavior signals a halt/all-stop style polygon breach.

max_time.description: The max allowable time in seconds.

max_depth.description: Sets the maximum allowable ownship depth in meters. A non-positive value leaves the depth limit disabled.

min_altitude.description: Sets the minimum allowable ownship altitude above the bottom in meters. A non-positive value leaves the altitude limit disabled.

save_poly.description: Defines the soft recovery polygon. When the vehicle exits this polygon, the behavior may produce an IvP function to guide it back inside before a harder halt breach occurs.

reset.description: Resets a previously breached OpRegion condition back to its launch-like monitoring state. This is most useful when sent through the behavior updates variable during a mission.

recover_spd.description: The preferred speed for the vehicle when it is out of the save polygon, attempting to maneuver back in. The speed should be high enough to enable a turn, but likely slower than normal in case an exit is inevitable for other reasons. The default value is 0.8 meters per second.

trigger_entry_time.description: The time required for the vehicle to have been within the halt polygon before triggering the halt polygon requirement.

trigger_exit_time.description: The time required to have been outside the polygon before declaring a polygon containment failure.

trigger_on_poly_entry.description: If true, the vehicle must first be in the halt polygon before the halt polygon constraint is enabled. The default is true.

visual_hints.description: Hints for visual properties in variables posted intended for rendering.

decay.description: Time interval during which extrapolated position slows to a halt.

exit_on_filter_group.description: If true, and if an exclusion filter is implemented for this contact behavior, an early exit of the behavior may be allowed when or if the group name changes and no longer satisfies the exclusion filter. The default is false.

exit_on_filter_vtype.description: If true, and if an exclusion filter is implemented for this contact behavior, an early exit of the behavior may be allowed when or if the vehicle type changes and no longer satisfies the exclusion filter. The default is false.

extrapolate.description: If true, contact position is extrapolated from last position and trajectory.

ignore_name.description: Excludes contacts with the configured name before the behavior treats them as valid.

tur1_rad.description: The turn radius of the turn following vertex 1. Any positive value is allowed (yes, any, be carefull), and the default is 15 meters.

turn_bias.description: The bias value, [−100, 100], may be adjusted with this parameter affecting the turn shape at both vertices. A value of −100 will result in a Williamson turn with its longest end aligned with the legrun track line (recommended). The default value is 0.

turn_bias_mod.description: The bias value for the turn as vertex 1, may be dynamically adjusted with this parameter, during run time, affecting the turn shape at both vertices. The given value will be added to the existing value. The resulting value will be clipped to the range [−100, 100].

turn_delay.description: Duration in seconds at the start of turn before requesting a heading change, presumably to allow for a speed adjustment befor turning.

turn_dir.description: The default turn direction for any turn that does specify a direction. The default direction is port.
The turn direction, "port" or "starboard", the vehicle will turn around both ver- tices. Acceptable parameter values are "port", "starboard", "star", or "toggle". The default is "star".

turn_endflag.description: A flag to be published at the end of each leg as the behavior transitions from either the turn1 mode into the leg2 mode, or from the turn2 mode into the leg1 mode.

turn_ext.description: An additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on both ends, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn_ext_mod.description: For both turns, modify the turn extent, an additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on both ends, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn_pt_gap.description: The distance between points comprising the Williamson turns on both ends. The default is 25 meters.

turn_rad.description: The turn radius of the turn following both vertices. Any positive value is allowed (yes, any, be carefull), and the default is 15 meters.

turn_rad_min.description: A minimum turn radius is enforced when dynamically adjusting the turn radius with the turn* rad mod parameters. This min radius is 5 meters. This can be changed with this parameter, but cannot be set lower than 2 meters.

turn_rad_mod.description: The turn radius of the turn at both vertices may be modified with this parameter. It cannot be set lower than the value of turn rad min.

turn_range.description: The range of heading values deviating from the current heading average outside of which the behavior reflects sharp penalty in its objective function. The default value is -1, indicating that the parameter is un-set. In this case the behavior will not produce an objective function.

turn_spec.description: A full specification for a scheduled turn.

turn1_bias.description: The bias value, [−100, 100], may be adjusted with this parameter affecting the turn shape at vertex 1. A value of −100 will result in a Williamson turn with its longest end aligned with the legrun track line (recommended). The default value is 0.

turn1_bias_mod.description: The bias value for the turn as vertex 1, may be dynamically adjusted with this parameter, during run time, affecting the turn shape at vertex 1. The given value will be added to the existing value. The resulting value will be clipped to the range [−100, 100].

turn1_dir.description: The turn direction, "port" or "starboard", the vehicle will turn around the first vertex. Acceptable parameter values are "port", "starboard", "star", or "toggle". The default is "star".

turn1_endflag.description: A flag to be published as the behavior transitions from the turn1 mode into the leg2 mode.

turn1_ext.description: An additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 1, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn1_ext_mod.description: Modify the turn 1 extent, an additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 1, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn1_rad_mod.description: The turn radius of the turn at vertex 1 may be modified with this parameter. It cannot be set lower than the value of turn rad min.

turn2_bias.description: The bias value, [−100, 100], may be adjusted with this parameter affecting the turn shape at vertex 2. A value of −100 will result in a Williamson turn with its longest end aligned with the legrun track line (recommended). The default value is 0.

turn2_bias_mod.description: The bias value for the turn as vertex 1, may be dynamically adjusted with this parameter, during run time, affecting the turn shape at vertex 2. The given value will be added to the existing value. The resulting value will be clipped to the range [−100, 100].

turn2_dir.description: The turn direction, "port" or "starboard", the vehicle will turn around the second vertex. Acceptable parameter values are "port", "starboard", "star", or "toggle". The default is "star".

turn2_endflag.description: A flag to be published as the behavior transitions from the turn2 mode into the leg1 mode.

turn2_ext.description: An additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 2, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn2_ext_mod.description: Modify the turn 2 extent, an additional distance, applied beyond the distance of the track leg on turn 2, before the vehicle begins its turn. The default value is 0.

turn2_rad.description: The turn radius of the turn following vertex 2. Any positive value is allowed (yes, any, be carefull), and the default is 15 meters.

turn2_rad_mod.description: The turn radius of the turn at vertex 2 may be modified with this parameter. It cannot be set lower than the value of turn rad min.
